description: Safely replace the text of one run in a story. Only the text content changes — layout geometry, styles, and all other XML are preserved byte-for-byte, so the document cannot be corrupted. Writes in place unless outPath is given.

outPath.description: Write result here instead of overwriting the input

runIndex.description: Run index within the story (from idml_get_story)

name: idml_set_text
